summary: Global Ship Lease, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, reporting its second-quarter 2026 financial results. The press release highlights operating revenue of $198.7 million for Q2, net income of $89.3 million, and a quarterly dividend of $0.625 per share. It also announces an order for 15 newbuild containerships at $1.33 billion, forward sales of four non-core ships, and credit rating updates. These are ordinary operational and financial disclosures, not a special-situation event. The newbuild order and ship sales are routine capital expenditures and asset dispositions within normal course, not a classified transaction. No special-situation category applies.
